name: Supply Crate · heavy · bright category glyph
notes:
Category review import, 1 Nov 2026. Original abstract devotional machine glyph replaces winged military decal. Glyph is a proposed shared equipment mark, not established faction lore. Generated sheet extracted to a 12-source-pixel art grid, 24-colour native interpretation; source and small details may differ after reduction. Separate material/emissive layers; no baked bloom. Native pixel cleanup and game-scale, anchor and animation review pending. Red is the dominant equipment light; neutral charcoal materials, amber heat. Draft saved for review only, not approved or integrated. Placement role: ground.
Complete heavy crate variant with canonical category colour (255, 178, 30). Frames and geometry retained; functional mark fitted into central panel. Other category variants are versions in the same crate family; coloured masks remain separate existing states. Category spawning is runtime work for Claude.
Readability revision: central category symbol redrawn at 9×9 with 2–3 px strokes and full 255-alpha emission. Arms: paired cartridges; heavy: shell; medical: cross; tools: crossed implements. Canonical category hues retained; casing, baseline, scale and side lamps unchanged. Uses current category-coloured bloom renderer.
